topic: What if the Moon disappeared tonight?
title: WHAT IF THE MOON
DISAPPEARED TONIGHT?

youtube.title: What If the Moon Disappeared Tonight?
tags: what if there was no moon
youtube.intro:
At 9:47 PM the Moon simply blinks out. No explosion, no rocks, just a black hole in the sky where it used to be. At first it's beautiful: the darkest night you've ever seen and the Milky Way across the whole sky. Then the tides shrink, the corals lose their calendar, and a hundred baby sea turtles crawl the wrong way.

An original animated story with original characters. The science behind it is real; sources are in the chapter notes and the pinned comment.
youtube.pinned_comment:
Would you have turned off the lights? 🐢👇

And what do you think is still pulling on the ocean? Best theory gets pinned before Part 2.

The science is real: the Sun's pull on the tides is less than half the Moon's (NOAA), the Bay of Fundy rises about 16 m, and hatchlings crawl toward the brightest horizon, which is why beach towns turn the lights off in nesting season.
